name: Chinese Calligraphy
visualIdentity: Explicit: the style centers on authentic calligraphic gesture, character spacing, and negative space. Vertical text, vermilion seals, and limited imagery may support the piece. Script and wording must stay consistent and accurate, and glyphs must never be stretched into incorrect forms.
suitableUses: Explicit: the combination guidance names poetry and cultural greetings as best-fit uses. Inferred: the calligraphic subtitles and seal imagery suit cultural or literary content. Other subjects, such as product or editorial work, are unspecified.
limitations: Glyphs must be verified against the intended script, and stroke order must be respected. Outlining a font does not count as brush-stroke animation. Characters must not be stretched. Calligraphy works best alone, with any ink imagery kept secondary. A simulated appearance is not evidence of physical production.
palette: Suggested, not approved: background #F5EFDE (paper), foreground #20211E (ink), accent_1 #B4382A (vermilion seal). Gradients are disabled, so use discrete tokens. Task-supplied colors override these. Contrast: foreground on background 14.089; background text on accent 5.165. These are two-color checks only, so verify text against composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Explicit: writing animation requires separate stroke paths in the correct order, revealed through complete groups or actual stroke order. Suggested tools: GSAP DrawSVGPlugin for stroke length, with optional Motion for DOM or SVG layers. Video motion derives from composition time. Interactive behavior is unspecified. Optional catalog motions (motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 storytelling) are used only if the scene supports them; none is required.
audio: Unspecified in the source. No audio asset is supplied or required. Suggested options, to be justified by topic and reading holds, include restrained music, voiceover, sound accents, ambience, or silence. Any audio must be authorized and must not compete with narration or essential text. No specific genre, tempo, or instrument is assigned.
assetRequirements: Explicit: authentic calligraphy assets or verified glyph paths are required, with separate ordered stroke paths for animation. Inputs may be alpha-channel layers, numbered frame sequences, or a layer manifest, with consistent dimensions and clear naming. Fonts and assets must load before rendering. Seal and imagery assets are optional.
combinations: Explicit: one suggested combination pairs this style with style-038, limited ink-wash imagery that fades in after the calligraphy completes. Rules: calligraphy dominates, only black and vermilion are used, and stroke order is verified. Avoid outlined fonts as strokes, stretched characters, and large wash areas. Other combinations are unspecified.
productionApproach: Explicit: HyperFrames is the default pipeline, with a paused, seekable GSAP timeline registered in window.__timelines, followed by check, snapshot, and render commands. Remotion is a fallback only when its documented condition is met and recorded. Visuals use SVG paths; chroma.js validates colors. Inspect opening, action, transition, and closing frames, plus glyphs, legibility, audio sync, and loop seams.
